Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
Phinehas_1: Eleazar's son, Aaron's grandson (Exodus 6:25) given a covenant of peace and perpetual priesthood (Numbers 25:13)
Ahitub_2: (grand) father of Zadok the priest (2 Samuel 8:17, 1 Chronicles 9:11), son of Amariah (1 Chronicles 6:11)
Azariah_1: son [descendant] of Zadok, served as priest (1 Kings 4:2) in the temple which Solomon built (1 Chronicles 6:10)
Seraiah_2: the chief priest (2 Kings 25:18) who was killed by the king of Babylon (2 Kings 25:21)
Bukki_2: son of Abishua and father of Uzzi (1 Chronicles 6:5)
Uzzi_1: son of Bukki (1 Chronicles 6:5) and father of Zerhiah (1 Chronicles 6:6)
Meraioth_1: father of Amariah (1 Chronicles 6:7), Levite (1 Chronicles 6:1)
Amariah_1: son of Meraioth (1 Chronicles 6:7) and father of Ahitub (1 Chronicles 6:7)
Zadok_3: (grand)son of Ahitub and father of Shallum (1 Chronicles 6:12)
Shallum_6: son of Zadok (1 Chronicles 6:12) and father of Hilkiah (1 Chronicles 6:13), Levite (1 Chronicles 6:1)
Hilkiah_3: son of Shallum and father of Azariah (1 Chronicles 6:13), stood on Ezra's right hand as he read from the Law (Nehemiah 8:4)
Azariah_7: son of Hilkiah (1 Chronicles 6:13), father of Seriah (1 Chronicles 6:14), and priest (Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7, Nehemiah 12:1), explained the law to the people (Nehemiah 8:7)
Ezra_1: son of Seraiah (Ezra 7:1), scribe skilled in the Law (Ezra 7:6)
